info.title: API.SH: Humble Bundle
info.description: The Humble Bundle API from API.SH: public Humble Bundle data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A bundle: tiers with their prices and items, every item (type, developers, publishers, value, platforms, store it activates on, region locks, ratings, description, video), preset prices, average price, purchases, money raised for charity, charities, revenue split, end date and other bundles. Give `id` or `url`, or `type` alone for a bundle of that kind on sale now. `top_contributors` is the bundle's public leaderboard (the name each buyer chose and the amount).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/humble-bundle

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Bundle path like `games/15th-anniversary-scifi-exposure`, or its humblebundle.com link.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A humblebundle.com bundle link instead of `id`.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Without id: a bundle of this kind on sale now.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Two-letter country for prices and currency (default US).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Humble Store products with every store filter and sort: search text, on sale or new releases, genre, platform, store the key activates on (Steam, GOG, DRM-free ...), developer, publisher. Each product: name, link, price, full price, discount, platforms, delivery, sale end, images. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/humble-store-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search text.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort (default bestselling, the store's relevance order).

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: All (default), on sale or new releases.

parameters.name: genre
parameters.description: Genre.

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: Platform.

parameters.name: drm
parameters.description: Where the key activates (`download` = DRM-free).

parameters.name: developer
parameters.description: Developer name.

parameters.name: publisher
parameters.description: Publisher name.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number from 1.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Two-letter country for prices and currency (default US).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
